blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Text-to-CAD generation aims to make CAD modeling more accessible by generating executable CAD programs from natural-language descriptions. However, practical CAD workflows require more than executable geometry: generated programs should also expose reusable structure that supports later modification. We introduce intent-oriented text-to-CAD generation, where design intent is expressed as recoverable code-level signals: semantic features, reusable parameters, and lightweight parametric relations. Rather than changing the model architecture or decoding procedure, we investigate how supervision representation granularity affects both CAD generation and zero-shot intent-preserving editing. To enable this study, we construct IntentCAD-100K, a 100K paired text--code dataset built by converting low-level CAD construction traces into executable CadQuery programs. We further construct IntentCAD-Edit-1K to evaluate zero-shot intent-preserving editing from the same representation perspective. Intent2CAD uses a two-stage conservative lifting pipeline: semantic lifting rewrites reliable primitive groups into feature-level operations, while parametric lifting exposes lightweight parametric relations. Under controlled fine-tuning, semantic lifting mainly improves generation reliability and feature recovery, reducing IR from 2.39% to 0.22% and achieving 99.96% API Recovery, while parametric lifting makes reusable relation structure explicit and further improves relation-aware zero-shot editing. Datasets and code are available at https://github.com/JinboYang94/Intent2CAD.
blocks.zh: 文本到CAD生成旨在通过从自然语言描述生成可执行的CAD程序来使CAD模型更容易被取用. 然而,实用的CAD工作流程需要的不仅仅是可执行几何:生成的程序还应该暴露支持后期修改的可再用结构. 我们引入了面向意图的文本到CAD生成,其中设计意图表示为可被恢复的代码级信号:语义特征,可再用参数,和轻量级参数关系. 而不是改变模型架构或解码程序,我们调查监督代表颗粒性如何影响CAD生成和零镜头意图保留编辑. 为了能够进行这一研究,我们构建了IntentCAD-100K,一个由将低等CAD构造痕迹转换为可执行的CadQuery程序所构建的100K对文本编码数据集. 我们进一步构建了IntentCAD-Edit-1K,以从同样的代表角度评价零镜头意图保留编辑. Intent2CAD使用两相保守式起重管:语义起重将可靠的原始组重写为地物级操作,而参数起重则暴露出轻量级参数关系. 在有控制的微调下,语义提升主要能提高生成可靠性和特性恢复,使IR从2.39%降至0.22%并实现 99.96%的API. 恢复,而参数提升则使可再用的关系结构明确,并进一步改善了关系意识零发编辑. 数据集和代码见https://github.com/Jinbo Yang94/Intent2CAD.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Computer-Aided Design (CAD) is a fundamental tool in modern engineering design and manufacturing, where designers create, refine, and iterate product designs throughout the development process [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . Because traditional CAD workflows remain time-consuming and expertise-intensive [ 4 ] , recent text-to-CAD research has explored how Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate CAD scripts from natural language descriptions [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] . This direction is promising, but practical CAD modeling is not only about producing a final shape. In parametric CAD modeling, a generated CAD program should support later reuse and modification, not just match the final shape.
blocks.zh: 计算机辅助设计(CAD)是现代工程设计和制造中的一种基本工具,设计者在整个开发过程中创作,精炼并提炼出产品设计[1,2,3]. 由于传统的CAD工作流程仍然耗时而需要大量专业知识[4],最近的文本到CAD研究探讨了"大语言模型"(LLMs)如何从自然语言描述中生成CAD脚本[5,6,7,8,9,10]. 这个方向很有希望,但实用的CAD模型的制作并不仅仅是生产出最终形状. 在参数化CAD模型化中,生成的CAD程序应该支持后期再用和修改,而不仅仅是与最终形状相匹配.

blocks.en:
Most existing text-to-CAD studies therefore leave an important gap. They primarily focus on geometric fidelity and program executability [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] . These criteria are necessary, but they do not fully capture the needs of parametric CAD workflows [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] .
A program that approximates the target geometry with many low-level primitives may pass a shape metric, while still making a simple later edit, such as changing a shared radius or preserving symmetry, difficult to perform consistently.
In this paper, we call this broader requirement intent-oriented text-to-CAD generation : the generated program should not only reproduce the requested shape, but also expose recoverable code-level intent signals that support reuse and local refinement.
blocks.zh:
因此,大多数现有的文本对CAD研究都留下了重要的空白. 它们主要侧重于几何忠诚和程序可执行性[5、6、7、8、9]。 这些标准是必要的,但是它们没有充分反映参数化CAD工作流程[11,12,13]的需要.
一个将目标几何与许多低等原始相近的程序可能会通过一个形状度量,同时仍然会做一个简单的后期编辑,例如改变一个共享半径或保留对称性,难以一致地执行.
在本文中,我们称这种更广泛的要求面向意图的文本到CAD生成:生成的程序不仅应当复制所请求的形状,而且还会暴露出可回收的代码级意图信号,支持再利用和局部的完善.

blocks.en:
We use intent in a restricted sense, referring only to recoverable code-level signals such as supported semantic features, reusable parameters, and lightweight parametric relations, rather than full design history or constraint-solving processes [ 14 ] .
The supervision representation is important to this problem. Most current benchmarks are built from low-level construction traces composed of primitives such as lines, arcs, and circles [ 15 , 5 , 6 , 16 ] . While expressive, these traces can hide the semantic and parametric structure that makes CAD programs reusable and editable.
blocks.zh:
我们使用受限制的意向,仅指可被恢复的代码级信号,如被支持的语义特征,可再用参数,和轻量级参数关系等,而不是完整的设计历史或约束-解析过程[14].
监督代表对这一问题很重要。 目前的大多数基准都是由由线,弧等原始物和圆[15,5,6,16]所构成的低等建筑痕迹所建. 这些痕迹虽然具有表达性,但可以隐藏语义和参数结构,使得CAD程序可以重新被使用和编辑.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Illustration of the representation gap between primitive-only and semantic–parametric CAD supervision.
blocks.zh: 图1:对原始的和语义的-参数CAD监督之间的代表差距的描述。

blocks.en: Figure 1 illustrates this representation gap. Both forms can describe same geometry, but they expose different supervision signals: the primitive-only form emphasizes low-level primitives, whereas the semantic–parametric form makes high-level feature and reusable parameters explicit in code. This motivates our main question: when the model, training objective, text descriptions, and inference setup are fixed, how much does the target representation itself affect text-to-CAD generation and intent-preserving editing?
blocks.zh: 图1说明了这一代表性差距。 两种形式都能够描述相同的几何,但都暴露出不同的监督信号:原始-唯能形式强调低等原始人,而语义-参数形式则使高等特征和可再用参数在代码上明确. 这激发了我们的主要问题:当模型,培训目标,文本描述,以及推论设置被固定时,目标表述本身会在多大程度上影响文本到CAD生成和意图保留编辑?

blocks.en:
To answer this question, we introduce Intent2CAD , a semantic–parametric supervision representation implemented as executable CadQuery code.
Following a conservative “lift when reliable, preserve when uncertain” rule, Intent2CAD rewrites supported primitive groups into high-level CAD features when geometric and constraint evidence agree, while retaining low-level fallbacks for unsupported or ambiguous geometry.
It exposes four code-level representation elements: semantic features, explicit parameters, parametric relations, and fallbacks.
blocks.zh:
为了回答这个问题,我们引入了Intent2CAD,一种语义学-参数化监督代表作为可执行的CadQuery代码执行.
遵循保守的“可靠时升起,不确定时保留”规则,Intent2CAD在几何和约束证据一致时,将原始群体重写为高级CAD特征,同时保留低等回落,用于不支持或模糊的几何.
它暴露出四个代码级代表元素:语义特征,明确参数,参数关系,和倒置.

blocks.en:
We construct this representation through a two-stage lift-and-validate pipeline.
Stage I performs tag-preserving reconstruction and constraint-grounded semantic lifting, rewriting reliable primitive groups into feature-level CadQuery operations with explicit parameters.
Stage II performs restricted relation induction by local parameter rewriting, exposing shared variables and simple derived expressions when they pass execution, geometric consistency, and locality checks.
The pipeline produces three supervision granularities for study: primitive-only, semantic, and semantic–parametric supervision.
blocks.zh:
我们通过两阶段的升降和验证管道来构建这种代表。
第一阶段进行标记保存的重建 和约束的语义提升, 将可靠的原始组重写成特征级的 CadQuery 操作, 并有明确的参数 。
第二阶段通过本地参数重写进行限制关系诱导,在通过执行、几何一致性和地点检查时披露共享变量和简单衍生表达式。
管道生产出三个用于研究的监督颗粒:原始的、语义的和语义的-参数监督。

blocks.en:
Using this pipeline, we build IntentCAD-100K , a 100K paired text–code dataset derived from raw DeepCAD [ 15 ] construction sequences.
Beyond standard Invalid Ratio (IR) and Chamfer Distance (CD), we evaluate whether generated code recovers semantic features, preserves shared/equal parameters, and preserves derived parametric relations.
We further construct IntentCAD-Edit-1K , a zero-shot intent-preserving editing benchmark with 1K aligned Feature Edit (FE), Consistency-preserving Edit (CE), and Derived-Relation Edit (DE) samples.
Unlike prior text-based CAD editing work that trains specialized editors [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] , we use the same text-to-CAD generation checkpoints to evaluate local refinement while preserving representation-specific intent signals. We also evaluate visually grounded editing to examine target localization capacity with spatial descriptions.
blocks.zh:
利用这个管道,我们构建了IntentCAD-100K,一个由原始的DeepCAD[15]构造序列衍生出来的100K对文本-代码数据集.
在标准无效比(IR)和Chamfer距离(CD)之外,我们评价生成的代码是否恢复了语义特征,保存了共享/等参数,并保留了所衍生的参数关系.
我们进一步构建了IntentCAD-Edit-1K,一个以1K对齐的特性编辑(FE),一致性-保留编辑(CE),和 Derived-Relations Edit (DE) 样本的零镜头意图保留编辑基准.
与之前训练专业编辑[17,18,19]的基于文本的CAD编辑工作不同,我们使用相同的文本到CAD生成检查点来评价本地的完善,同时保留特定表达意图信号. 我们还对视网膜编辑进行评估,以审查具有空间描述的目标本地化能力。

blocks.en:
Experiments show that representation granularity has measurable effects.
Under the same supervised fine-tuning setup, semantic lifting reduces IR from 2.39% to 0.22%, lowers mean CD from 1.44 to 0.46 ( × 10 3 \times 10^{3} ), and achieves 99.96% API Recovery.
Parametric lifting keeps reliability and typical geometry comparable to semantic supervision, while recovering relation structure with 93.35% ERS and 95.25% PRS.
In zero-shot editing, semantic–parametric supervision further improves relation-aware edits, raising CE@ES from 91.00% to 95.82% and DE@ES from 77.09% to 88.73%. Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
blocks.zh:
实验显示,代表颗粒性具有可测量的效果.
在相同的有监督的微调设置下,语义提升将IR从2.39%降低到0.22%,将CD从1.44降低到0.46 (x10 3\times 10^{3}),并实现99.96%的API回收.
参数起重保持了可靠性和典型几何学与语义监督的可比性,同时以93.35%的ERS和95.25%的PRS来恢复关系结构.
在零镜头编辑中,语义-参数监督进一步改善了对关系的认识编辑,将CE@ES从91.00%提高到95.82%,将DE@ES从77.09%提高到88.73%. 我们的贡献可归纳如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce intent-oriented text-to-CAD generation as a representation-centered formulation that goes beyond executable geometry by focusing on recoverable semantic features, reusable parameters, and lightweight parametric relations. • We construct IntentCAD-100K , a large-scale aligned text–code dataset that converts low-level CAD construction traces into primitive-only, semantic, and semantic–parametric executable CadQuery targets through our automated conservative lifting-and-validation pipeline. • We construct IntentCAD-Edit-1K as a validation benchmark for studying how representation granularity affects zero-shot intent-preserving editing, covering feature edits, consistency-preserving edits, and derived-relation edits without edit-specific training. • Experiments show that semantic lifting improves generation reliability and feature-level editability, while parametric lifting improves relation preservation and relation-aware editing.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Symbolic CAD Representations for Text-to-CAD
blocks.zh: 2.1 文本对CAD的符号化CAD代表

blocks.en:
Text-to-CAD differs from general shape generation [ 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 ] because the symbolic output should be an editable construction program, not only a final geometry.
Prior work has therefore adopted symbolic CAD targets, including sketch-and-extrude sequences, primitive and constraint graphs, domain-specific CAD formats, and executable CAD code [ 15 , 24 , 5 , 6 , 8 , 9 , 25 ] .
Early approaches represent CAD models as low-level construction traces over primitives such as lines, arcs, circles, and extrusion commands [ 15 , 24 ] , while recent text-conditioned systems extend these targets to natural-language generation and executable CadQuery code [ 5 , 6 , 8 , 9 ] .
However, a code target alone does not determine the semantic quality of the representation.
Existing supervision is still largely derived from primitive-level traces, which scale well but leave feature grouping, editable variables, and geometric or parametric relations implicit.
This limits their ability to expose the modeling structure needed for refinement and reuse.
Our work addresses this representation gap by constructing aligned primitive-only, semantic, and semantic–parametric targets.
blocks.zh:
文本到CAD与一般形状生成[20, 21, 22, 23]不同,因为符号输出应该是一个可编辑的构造程序,而不仅仅是最终几何.
因此,先前的工作采用了象征性的CAD目标,包括草图和外延序列,原始和约束图,域特有CAD格式,以及可执行的CAD代码[15,24,5,6,8,9,25].
早期的方法代表了CAD模型作为线,弧,圆等原始物上低等构造痕迹,并被挤出指令 [15,24],而最近的文本条件系统将这些目标扩展到自然语言生成和可执行的CadQuery代码 [5,6,8,9].
然而,仅一个代码目标并不能决定表达的语义质量.
现有的监督仍然主要来源于原始层面的痕迹,这些痕迹的尺度很好但留下了特征分组,可编辑变量,以及几何或参数关系所隐含.
这限制了它们揭露改进和再利用所需的模型结构的能力。
我们的工作通过构建一致的原始、语义和语义参数目标来解决这一代表性差距。

blocks.en: 2.2 Design Intent in Parametric CAD Modeling
blocks.zh: 2.2 参数CAD模型设计意图

blocks.en:
Design intent in parametric CAD modeling describes how a model is expected to behave under modification [ 11 , 12 ] .
A geometrically valid model may still be poorly editable if feature structure, dimensions, or relations are lost [ 13 ] .
Prior work has studied such relational structure in constraint-based sketches [ 26 , 27 ] , including primitive–constraint graph representations [ 24 ] and constrained sketch generation with automatic constraint completion [ 28 ] .
Our work extends this editability perspective to code-based parametric 3D CAD.
Rather than reconstructing a full constraint system or using solver feedback, we expose recoverable code-level signals, such as semantic features, reusable parameters, and lightweight parametric relations, directly in executable CAD programs.
blocks.zh:
参数化CAD模型中的设计意图描述一个模型在修改下如何预期行为[11,12].
如果特征结构,维度,或关系丢失[13],一个几何有效的模型仍然可能编辑不当.
以前的工作研究了这种基于约束的草图中的关系结构[26,27],包括原始的-约束图示[24]和带有自动约束完成的限制性草图生成[28].
我们的工作将这个可编辑性视角延伸至基于代码的参数3D CAD.
我们不是重建一个完全的制约系统或使用解析器反馈,而是直接在可执行的CAD程序中暴露可恢复的代码级信号,如语义特性,可再用参数,和轻量级参数关系.

blocks.en: 2.3 LLM-based Text-to-CAD Generation and Editing
blocks.zh: 2.3 基于 LLM 的文本对 CAD 生成和编辑

blocks.en:
LLMs have recently been applied to text-to-CAD through sequential command prediction [ 5 , 6 ] , B-rep-grounded command generation with pointer-based entity selection [ 29 ] , multimodal generation with visual feedback [ 7 ] , and direct generation of executable CAD code [ 9 , 8 , 10 ] .
Parallel efforts study controllable generation and text-guided editing, including hierarchy-aware control [ 19 ] , local geometry control [ 18 ] , locate-then-infill editing [ 17 ] , and unified CAD prototyping with dedicated tokenization [ 30 ] .
CAD-Tokenizer [ 30 ] learns compact, primitive-aware tokens for generation and editing, while cadrille [ 31 ] focuses on multimodal CAD reconstruction from text, images, and point clouds.
However, existing work rarely studies the semantic and parametric granularity of the supervision target itself.
Execution and geometric checks verify whether a CAD program runs and matches the target shape, but do not ensure reusable feature semantics or meaningful parametric relations.
Rather than proposing another editor or decoding pipeline, our work focuses on the upstream target representation and studies whether explicit semantic–parametric supervision improves learning and editability under standard supervised fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
LLMs最近通过相继指令预测[5,6],以指针为基础的实体选择的B-rep-rep-fround指令生成[29],以可视反馈的多模式生成[7],以及直接生成可执行的CAD代码[9,8,10]被应用于文本到CAD.
并行努力研究可控生成和文本制导编辑,包括分级感知控制 [19],局部几何控制 [18],定位-当时-填充编辑 [17],并统一CAD原型并有专用标注 [30].
CAD-Tokenizer [30] 学习紧凑的,原始的-意识的符号用于生成和编辑,而cadrille [31] 则从文本,图像,和点云中专注于多式CAD重建.
然而,现有工作很少研究监督目标本身的语义和参数颗粒性。
执行和几何检查验证一个 CAD 程序是否运行并匹配目标形状,但不能保证可重复使用的特征语义或有意义的参数关系.
我们的工作重点不是提出另一个编辑或解码管道,而是研究上游目标表述以及明确的语义-参数监督是否在标准监督下的微调下改善学习和编辑。

blocks.en: 3 Method: Intent-Explicit Supervision for Text-to-CAD
blocks.zh: 3 方法:对文本至计算机辅助数据进行故意监督

blocks.en: 3.1 Intent2CAD: Intent-Explicit CadQuery Representation
blocks.zh: 3.1 意向2CAD:意向-意向-意向性线索查询

blocks.en:
Intent2CAD provides semantic–-parametric representation supervision for intent-oriented text-to-CAD generation. Rather than changing the model architecture, training objective, or decoding procedure, it changes the representation of the target code that the model is trained to produce.
In this way, each CAD program is represented as executable CadQuery code in which recoverable design intent is made explicit : semantic features expose reusable CAD modeling operations , explicit parameters name editable design variables , and lightweight parametric relations capture simple geometric and parameter relations , while low-level fallbacks retain coverage for complex geometry . This allows standard supervised fine-tuning to learn not only the resulting executable geometry, but also how that geometry is constructed and parameterized.
blocks.zh:
Intent2CAD为面向意向的文本到CAD生成提供语义-参数表示监督. 与其改变模型架构,培训目标,或解码程序,不如改变模型被训练出的目标代码的表示.
这样,每个 CAD 程序都以可执行的 CadQuery 代码表示,其中可回收设计意图被明确 : 语义特性暴露了可再使用的 CAD 模型操作 ; 明确参数名称可编辑设计变量 ; 轻量级参数关系捕捉了简单的几何和参数关系 ; 而低等回落则保留了复杂几何的覆盖 . 这使得标准有监督的微调不仅可以学习由此产生的可执行几何,还可以学习该几何的构造和参数化方法.

blocks.en:
By contrasting the two supervision representations of the same CAD instance, Figure 2 illustrates how Intent2CAD changes the supervision target.
The primitive-only target keeps the recovered construction as low-level primitives, where semantic structures appear as segments, arcs, and repeated numeric constants.
In the semantic–parametric target, recoverable primitive groups are rewritten into semantic CAD operations such as rect , editable attributes are named as explicit parameters such as radii , widths , heights , and centers , and related values are represented through shared variables or simple derived expressions.
For example, proportional radii and symmetric centers are exposed as code-level relations, as indicated by the red boxes and arrows.
Unsupported primitive groups remain as low-level fallback loops to preserve executable coverage for complex geometry.
The intermediate semantic target used in the controlled study stops before relation lifting: it keeps the semantic feature rewrites, but lacks explicit parameters and relations.
blocks.zh:

We define the supported operations based on common CadQuery modeling patterns that can be reliably recovered from low-level sketch–extrude traces using geometric checks and source constraint evidence.
This conservative set includes semantic CAD construction commands, such as rect , regular polygon , irregular polygon , slot , fillet , and array , as well as lightweight sketch relation cues, including PARALLEL , HORIZONTAL , VERTICAL , PERPENDICULAR , and TANGENT .
To make repeated or related values more editable than repeated numeric constants, Intent2CAD further introduces a restricted set of recoverable code-level relation signals, including EQUAL , CONCENTRIC , MIRROR , DISTANCE , and common RATIO relations between dimensional parameters.
Equal lengths, radii, or centers are represented by shared variables, while mirrored or distance-based structures are represented through symmetric or offset parameter definitions.
These relations are not a full constraint system; they expose recurring geometric and parametric regularities in code.

这个保守的集包括语义CAD构造指令,如矩形,正多边形,不规则多边形,槽,平板,和阵列等,以及轻量级草图关系提示,包括PARALLEL,HORIZONTAL,VERTICAL,PERPENDICULAR和TANGENT.
为了使重复值或相干值比重复数常数更能被编辑,Intent2CAD进一步引入了一套限制性的可回收代码级关系信号,包括EQUAL,CONCENTRIC,MIROR,DISTANCE,和维度参数之间的常见RATIO关系.

blocks.en: 3.2 Lift-and-Validate Construction Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.2 起重管道

blocks.en: To construct Intent2CAD supervision at scale, we introduce an automatic lift-and-validate construction pipeline that converts each raw CAD sample into a paired text–code instance. The pipeline combines deterministic geometric checks, recovered constraint evidence, constrained LLM-based local rewriting, and executable validation, without requiring manual annotation of semantic features or parameter relations. Candidate lifts or rewrites are accepted only when their reliability can be established; otherwise, the original low-level implementation is preserved. This makes the construction process scalable while keeping the generated target code executable and geometrically faithful.
blocks.zh: 为了在规模上构建Intent2CAD监理,我们引入了自动升降和验证的施工管道,将每个原始CAD样本转换成一对文本-代码实例。 管线结合了确定几何的检查,找回的制约证据,受限的LLM本地重写,以及可执行的验证,而不需要人工注释语义特征或参数关系. 候选人起重机或重写机只有在其可靠性能够确定时才能被接受;否则,原低级执行被保留. 这使得构造过程在保持所生成的目标代码可执行和几何忠实的同时可以被扩展.

The intermediate programs are retained, yielding three aligned supervision granularities : the primitive reconstruction before lifting, the Stage-I semantic program, and the Stage-II semantic–parametric program.

blocks.en:
We evaluate Intent2CAD on IntentCAD-100K, which is constructed by applying the conversion pipeline in Section 3.2 to 178,238 raw construction sequences from DeepCAD [ 15 ] .
We retain samples that can be converted into executable CadQuery programs, normalized to a canonical coordinate scale, and passed through geometric validity checks; samples with unsupported operations or unrecoverable sketch/extrusion structure are discarded.
Before splitting, we also remove duplicate primitive reconstructions using a quantized construction signature computed before semantic and parametric lifting, ensuring that the three supervision representations remain aligned after deduplication and reducing leakage from duplicate construction records.
The final benchmark contains 100K paired text–code samples, randomly split into training, validation, and test sets with a ratio of 80/10/10. Appendix A reports the data distribution, conversion pipeline, and duplicate-removal details.

We construct three edit types that directly correspond to the intent-bearing structures exposed by our representation. (1) Feature Edit (FE): replace a semantic feature or modify its attributes while preserving the remaining relations. (2) Consistency Edit (CE): change one editable value while preserving equality-like relations encoded by shared variables or shared geometric references, such as EQUAL dimensions or CONCENTRIC centers. The final benchmark contains 1K samples, including 414 FE, 311 CE, and 275 DE samples.

AR is computed as a feature-level F1 score between predicted and ground-truth semantic feature classes after normalizing equivalent CadQuery implementations. For relation preservation, we propose Equal Relation Score (ERS) for equality-like shared-parameter relations and Parametric Relation Score (PRS) for lightweight derived relations.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评价面向意图的生成质量,我们提议恢复API特性。 AR在使等同的CadQuery执行正常化后,作为预测和地真语义特征类之间的特征级F1分数来计算. 为了维护关系,我们提议平等关系分数用于平等式的共享参数关系和轻量级衍生关系等参数关系分数。

blocks.en: For zero-shot editing on IntentCAD-Edit-1K, each representation uses its corresponding generation checkpoint without additional editing training. We use Edit Success Rate (ES) as the primary metric, defined as the percentage of edit samples whose outputs are executable and satisfy the target edit specification after variable resolution and normalization of equivalent implementations. We report FE@ES, CE@ES, and DE@ES for the three edit categories introduced in part of IntentCAD-Edit-1K Construction , and retain Median CD only as a weak compatibility metric because global point-cloud distance is often insensitive to small but functionally important local edits. Appendix B provides the full normalization rules and metric definitions.
blocks.zh: 对于IntentCAD-Edit-1K上的0shot编辑,每个代表使用其相应的生成检查点而无需额外的编辑训练. 我们使用编辑成功率(ES)作为主要衡量标准,定义是输出可执行并满足可变分辨率和等同执行正常化后目标编辑规格的编辑样本的百分比。 我们为IntentCAD-Edit-1K Construction部分引入的三种编辑类别报告FE@ES、CE@ES和DE@ES,并将Medien CD仅作为弱相容度量,因为全球点-云相距往往对小型但功能上重要的本地编辑不敏感。 附 录 B提供了完全正常化的规则和衡量标准的定义。

blocks.en: 4.2 Diagnostic Baseline Comparison
blocks.zh: 4.2 基线比较

blocks.en: We first examine how existing text-to-CAD models and general-purpose LLMs transfer to intent-oriented prompts. We evaluate frontier LLMs with direct prompting and include both CAD-Coder [ 8 ] and the text-conditioned setting of cadrille [ 31 ] , two dedicated models fine-tuned for CadQuery generation on their own datasets. Since these CAD-specific models are trained on different text–code distributions, this comparison is intended as a transfer diagnostic rather than a controlled representation comparison. While both IntentCAD-100K and CAD-Coder’s dataset use expert-level text instructions, IntentCAD-100K prompts explicitly describe common geometric features and lightweight relation structures for intent-oriented text-to-CAD generation.
blocks.zh: 我们首先审查现有文本对计算机辅助数据模型和通用有限责任公司如何向意图导向的提示转移。 我们用直接的提示来评估前沿有限责任公司,包括CAD-Coder[8]和以文字为条件的Cadrille[31]的设置,两个专用模型在自己的数据集上对CadQuery生成进行了微调。 由于这些CAD特定模型都经过了不同文本-代码分布的培训,因此这种比较旨在作为转移诊断,而不是对照表示比较. 虽然IntentCAD-100K和CAD-Coder的数据集都使用专家级的文本指令,但IntentCAD-100K 提示明确描述了通用的几何特征和轻量级关系结构,用于面向意图的文本到CAD生成.

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that intent-oriented prompts are not handled reliably by existing systems. General-purpose LLMs suffer from high invalid ratios, indicating that strong general code-generation ability does not directly translate into reliable CadQuery generation under intent-oriented instructions. CAD-Coder and cadrille achieve much lower invalid ratio, but their worse CD and AR suggest limited transfer to our intent-oriented setting, where both geometric fidelity and semantic feature recovery are required. After IntentCAD SFT, both open-source backbones obtain much lower invalid ratios and substantially better geometric and feature recovery.
blocks.zh: 表1显示,现有系统无法可靠地处理以意图为导向的提示。 通用LLMs的无效比率很高,这表明强大的通用代码生成能力并没有在意图导向指令下直接转化为可靠的CadQuery生成. CAD-Coder和Cadrille的无效比例要低得多,但它们的更糟糕的CD和AR表明,我们只能有限地转向以意图为导向的环境,在这种情况下,需要几何忠诚度和语义特征恢复。 在IntentCAD SFT之后,两个开源主干线都获得了更低的无效比率,并大大改善了几何和特征恢复.

blocks.en: These results motivate IntentCAD-100K as a challenging intent-oriented benchmark, but they do not by themselves isolate which part of the representation matters. We therefore turn to controlled comparisons in Section 4.3 , where the data split, backbone, training strategy, and inference setting are fixed, and the supervision representation is varied.
blocks.zh: 这些结果促使IntentCAD-100K作为一个具有挑战性的意图导向基准,但它们本身并不孤立代表的哪一部分很重要。 因此,我们转而在第4.3节中进行有控制的比较,在该节中,数据分割、主干、培训战略和推论设定是固定的,监督代表也各不相同。

blocks.en: Overall, semantic lifting improves reliability and geometric fidelity, while parametric lifting exposes reusable relation structure with little change to the primary generation metrics. This division supports the use of semantic–parametric targets for intent-oriented text-to-CAD generation and motivates the editability analysis in the next section. Appendix D reports auxiliary syntax validity and completion-token results, which provide additional comparisons across representations.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,语义起重可以提高可靠性和几何忠诚度,而参数起重则暴露出可再用的关系结构,很少改变初级生成度量. 此分法支持使用语义-参数指标来生成面向意图的文本到CAD,并激励下一节的可编辑性分析. 附 录 D报告辅助语法有效性和补全结果,这些结果提供了对表述的补充比较。

blocks.en: 4.4 Zero-shot Intent-Preserving Editing
blocks.zh: 4.4 零镜头意图保留编辑

blocks.en: We further evaluate whether the learned target representation supports local design refinement without edit-specific training. This experiment is not intended to solve general-purpose CAD editing, unlike prior works that train specialized editors for local infilling or masked-region modification from natural-language instructions [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] . Instead, it tests whether a model trained only for text-to-CAD generation can modify an intended feature while preserving the relevant semantic and parametric structure exposed by its representation.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价所学得的目标表述是否支持在不进行编辑培训的情况下改进当地设计。 这项实验无意解决通用的 CAD 编辑问题,与以往从自然语言指令[17,18,19]中培训专门编辑员进行本地填充或遮掩区域修改的作品不同. 相反,它测试一个只为文本到CAD生成而训练的模型是否能够在保留其表达所暴露的相关语义和参数结构的同时修改一个预期的特征.

blocks.en: We restrict the edit scope to the code-level intent signals studied in this paper: semantic features, equality-like relations over reusable parameters, and lightweight derived parametric relations. Given a source program and an edit instruction, the model outputs the full edited program using the corresponding generation checkpoint, with no additional editing fine-tuning. Each instruction explicitly refers to the edited object using its loop name in the source program. This intentionally factors out open-ended edit-target localization and isolates whether each representation supports the requested local modification once the target is identified.
blocks.zh: 我们把编辑范围限制在本文所研究的代码级意向信号上:语义特征,平等相比于可再使用参数的关系,以及轻量级衍生参数关系. 鉴于一个源程序和编辑指令,模型会使用相应的生成检查点输出完整的编辑程序,没有额外的编辑微调. 每个指令都明确指被编辑对象在源程序中使用其循环名称. 这种故意因素排除了开放式编辑目标本地化,并隔离了每个代表是否在目标确定后支持所要求的本地修改.

blocks.en: 4.5 Visually Grounded Editing
blocks.zh: 4.5 视地编辑

blocks.en: To isolate editing performance from target localization, the preceding zero-shot experiment uses explicit loop identifiers. We extend this evaluation to visually grounded editing using 200 cases from IntentCAD-Edit-1K with at least two candidate features (80 FE, 60 CE, and 60 DE). Loop identifiers are replaced with spatial descriptions while preserving the edit operations and target values. GPT-5.4 edits each aligned source program using the same four-view rendering and instruction. We also use GPT-5.4 to separately rate source program editability on a 0–10 scale without representation labels. Localization checks whether the intended target loop is modified, while ES additionally requires executable and correct edits, including relation–dependent updates.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en:
Several limitations define the current scope of Intent2CAD.
First, it supports only a conservative set of commonly recoverable semantic templates, leaving many long-tail engineering features in primitive form.
Extending semantic coverage to richer feature spaces remains important future work.
Second, the text descriptions are primarily expert-level prompts, and generalization to casual or underspecified instructions remains unstudied.
Third, our use of intent is limited to recoverable code-level signals rather than full design history or constraint-solving processes.
Finally, the conservative pipeline reduces incorrect supervision, but may leave some valid relations unlifted.
blocks.zh:
几个局限性定义了Intent2CAD目前的范围.
首先,它只支持一套保守的可通用的语义模板,留下许多长尾工程特征以原始形式存在.
将语义涵盖范围扩大到更丰富的地物空间仍然是今后的重要工作。
第二,文字说明主要是专家一级的提示,对临时或未充分说明的指示的概括仍然没有得到研究。
第三,我们的用意仅限于可恢复的代码级信号,而不是完整的设计历史或约束-解决过程.
最后,保守的管线减少了不正确的监督,但可能会使一些有效的关系得不到提升.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
This paper studied how semantic–parametric representation affects text-to-CAD generation under a controlled fine-tuning setup.
Intent2CAD changes the supervision target rather than the model architecture or decoding procedure, representing CAD programs as executable CadQuery code with recoverable semantic features, reusable parameters, lightweight parametric relations, and low-level fallbacks.
Our experiments suggest that semantic lifting improves reliability, geometric fidelity, feature recovery, and feature-level editing, while parametric lifting mainly benefits relation recovery and relation-aware edits.
These findings provide evidence that the symbolic form of CAD supervision can affect the structure learned by text-to-CAD models.
Within the scope of recoverable code-level intent signals, structured supervision appears to be a promising direction for generating CAD programs that are not only executable, but also more amenable to later refinement.
blocks.zh:
本文研究了在有控制的微调设置下,语义-参数表示法如何影响文本到CAD的生成.
Intent2CAD修改了监督目标而不是模型架构或解码程序,代表CAD程序是具有可被执行的可被执行语义特性的CadQuery代码,可重复使用的参数,轻量级参数关系,以及低等回落.
我们的实验表明,语义提升可以提高可靠性、几何忠诚度、特征恢复度和特征水平的编辑度,而参数提升主要有利于恢复和了解关系。
这些结论提供了证据,证明CAD监督的象征性形式会影响由文本到CAD模型所学到的结构.
在可回收的代码级意图信号范围内,结构化的监督似乎是生成CAD程序的一个有希望的方向,这些程序不仅可以执行,而且更适合以后的改进.

blocks.en: A.2 Duplicate Removal
blocks.zh: A.2 重复清除

blocks.en: Duplicate removal is performed after primitive CadQuery reconstruction and validity filtering, but before lifting and data splitting, ensuring that all three supervision representations remain aligned. Each primitive program is converted into an ordered construction signature from its operations and geometric arguments; floating-point values are rounded to four decimals and the serialized signature is hashed with SHA256. Duplicate hashes are removed after deterministic sorting.
blocks.zh: 重复去除是在原始的CadQuery重建和有效性过滤后进行,但在起重和数据分拆前进行,确保了所有三种监督表述保持一致. 每个原始程序都从其操作和几何参数中被转换成有秩序的构造签名;浮点值被四舍五入到四小数,而序列式签名被与SHA256并排. 重复的散列器在确定分类后被移除 。

blocks.en: This is construction-level rather than source-code or full geometric-equivalence deduplication: formatting differences are ignored, but programs with different operation orders or construction histories may remain distinct. This choice matches our setting, where CAD supervision depends on both final geometry and construction parameterization.
blocks.zh: 这是构造层面,而不是源代码或全几何等分解:格式化差异被忽略了,但具有不同操作命令或构造历史的程序可能仍然不同. 这个选择符合我们的设定, CAD 监管依赖于最终几何和构造参数化.

blocks.en: A.3 Semantic–Parametric Lifting Details
blocks.zh: A.3 语义 - 平面提升细节

blocks.en: Semantic lifting supports rectangles, regular and irregular polygons, slots, fillets, and arrays. Unsupported or ambiguous primitive groups are preserved as low-level fallbacks.
blocks.zh: 语义起重支持矩形,正多边形和不规则多边形,插槽,平方阵等. 不支持或模棱两可的原始群体被保留为低级倒置.

blocks.en: Parametric lifting targets EQUAL, CONCENTRIC, MIRROR, DISTANCE, and RATIO relations. These relations are represented in code as shared variables or simple derived expressions after validation. Implementation details of rewrite proposal and validation are described below.
blocks.zh: 参数提升目标EQUAL,CONCENTRIC,MIROR,DISTANCE,和RATIO关系. 这些关系在代码中作为共享变量或验证后简单的衍生表达式来表示. 下文介绍重写提案和验证的实施细节。

blocks.en: A.4 Validation and Text Description Generation Rules
blocks.zh: A.4 审定和文本描述生成规则

blocks.en: We execute each candidate CadQuery program. A program passes execution if it produces a valid non-empty solid whose volume can be queried successfully within 30 seconds.
blocks.zh: 我们执行每个候选人的考查程序 如果程序生成一个有效的非空固件, 它的音量可以在30秒内被成功询问, 则会通过执行 。

blocks.en: Since Chamfer Distance is randomly sampled, we compare the candidate program p ~ \tilde{p} against the Stage-I program p ( 1 ) p^{(1)} using deterministic values, such as solid volume, the six axis-aligned bounding-box coordinates, and the three center-of-mass coordinates. A rewrite is accepted only if every checked scalar invariant differs under 10 − 5 10^{-5} tolerance.
blocks.zh: 自从Chamfer之后 距离是随机抽样的,我们将候选程序p~\tilde{p}与阶段-I程序p (1)\p^{(1)}相比较,使用确定值,如固体体积,六轴相接的边框坐标,和三个质量中心坐标等. 重写只有在每个被检查的平面平面变化值在10 - 5 10 - 5 = 容忍度下不同时才被接受。

blocks.en: We parse both p ( 1 ) p^{(1)} and p ~ \tilde{p} into ASTs and verify that the geometric operation sequence, loop identifiers, feature calls, extrusion operations, Boolean operations, and sketch topology remain unchanged. The rewrite may only introduce or modify variable assignments and parameter expressions. It is rejected if it adds, removes, reorders, or changes geometric operations.
blocks.zh: 我们将 p ( 1 ) p ( 1) 和 p ~ tilde{ p} 分析到 AST 中, 并核实几何操作序列、 循环标识符、 特性调用、 外接操作、 布尔操作和草图地形都保持不变 。 重写只能引入或修改可变任务和参数表达式. 如果添加、去除、重排或改变几何操作,则拒绝。

blocks.en: For each accepted program, we use GPT-5.4 to generate one intent-oriented engineering description from the accepted CadQuery script and the recovered constraint summary. The generator is instructed to verbalize only code-supported geometry, dimensions, construction order, body operations, and explicitly represented relations. It is also instructed not to mention Python, CadQuery, API names, variable names, loop identifiers, or other code-level symbols. Numeric-equality-only groups are not described as shared relations unless they are explicitly supported by the accepted program or constraint summary.
blocks.zh: 对于每一个被接受的程序,我们使用GPT-5.4从被接受的CadQuery脚本和被恢复的制约摘要中生成一个面向意图的工程描述. 生成器被指示只将代码支持的几何,维度,构造顺序,机身操作等语言化,并明确代表关系. 还指示它不要提及 Python, CadQuery, API 名称,可变名称, 循环标识符, 或其他代码级符号. 仅限数平等的群体不被称为共有关系,除非它们得到公认的程序或约束摘要的明确支持.

blocks.en: A.5 Stage-wise Coverage and Validation
blocks.zh: A.5 分阶段覆盖和验证

blocks.en: Stage I fully recognizes the semantic structure in 82.68% of the retained IntentCAD-100K programs. Incomplete recognition arises from unsupported feature patterns, insufficient constraint evidence, or geometric deviations beyond the matching tolerance. Unrecognized portions remain in primitive form rather than being assigned uncertain semantic labels.
blocks.zh: 第一阶段完全承认82.68%保留了IntentCAD-100K程序中的语义结构. 不完全识别源于不支持的特征图案,不足的制约证据,或比对相容度以外的几何偏差. 未识别部分仍为原始形式,而不是被赋予不确定的语义标签。

blocks.en: Stage II proposes at least one relation rewrite for 34.24% of Stage-I programs. The absence of a proposal may reflect insufficient evidence or relations already encoded by semantic features. For example, parallelism and perpendicularity are intrinsic to rect . This percentage measures proposal coverage rather than the proportion of programs with accepted parametric lifting.
blocks.zh: 第二阶段提议至少为34.24%的第一阶段方案改写一个关系。 没有建议书可能反映已经由语义特征编码的证据或关系不充分. 例如,平行主义和相通性是矩形所固有的. 这一百分比衡量建议涵盖范围,而不是有公认的参数提升的方案比例。

blocks.en: Among 78,930 candidate rewrites, 70,238 (88.99%) pass deterministic validation. The remaining candidates are rejected when substitutions violate executability, geometric consistency, or locality. Rejected rewrites retain the Stage-I representation, while unsuccessful semantic lifting preserves the corresponding primitive operations. These fallbacks are distinct from the initial filtering of raw sequences that cannot be converted into executable programs.
blocks.zh: 在78,930名候选人中,70,238人(88.99%)通过了确定性鉴定。 当替代物违反可执行性、几何一致性或地点时,其余候选人将被拒绝。 被否决的重写保留了阶段一的表示,而不成功的语义提升保留了相应的原始操作. 这些倒置与原始序列的初始过滤不同,它们不能被转换为可执行程序.

blocks.en: B.1 Generation Metrics
blocks.zh: B.1 生成计量

blocks.en: Invalid Ratio (IR) is the fraction of predicted programs that fail to execute into a valid CadQuery solid. A prediction is considered executable if running the program produces an object whose solid volume can be queried successfully.
blocks.zh: 无效比 (IR) 是无法执行到有效的 CadQuery 固件的预测程序的分数 。 如果运行程序会产生一个可以成功查询其固体体积的对象,则预测被认为是可执行的 。

blocks.en: For executable predictions, we tessellate both the predicted and ground-truth CadQuery solids with a tolerance of 0.001 0.001 , uniformly sample 8192 surface points, normalize each point cloud by its maximum bounding-box extent, and compute symmetric squared Chamfer Distance. Following prior text-to-CAD works, reported CD values are multiplied by 10 3 10^{3} .
blocks.zh: 对于可执行预测,我们将预测的和地面真实的CadQuery固体以0.001 0.001的可耐性标出,统一地取取出8192个地表点,使每个地点云以最大边框范围实现常态化,并计算出对称平方相距. 在以往的文本到CAD工作之后,报告的CD值被乘以10 3 10^{3}.

blocks.en: API Recovery (AR) measures whether the generated code recovers the semantic feature calls used by the ground-truth program. We parse the predicted and target programs into Python ASTs and extract multisets of canonical feature labels. Equivalent API interfaces are mapped to the same feature label when applicable, e.g., slot and slot2D are both mapped to slot , pushPoints , rarray , and polarArray are mapped to array . Given ground-truth and predicted feature multisets M g M_{g} and M p M_{p} , AR is computed as the F1 score: P = | M g ∩ M p | | M p | , R = | M g ∩ M p | | M g | , A ​ R = 2 ​ P ​ R P + R . P=\frac{|M_{g}\cap M_{p}|}{|M_{p}|},\quad R=\frac{|M_{g}\cap M_{p}|}{|M_{g}|},\quad AR=\frac{2PR}{P+R}. Samples without ground-truth canonical features are excluded from AR calculation.
blocks.zh: API Recovery (AR) 测量生成的代码是否恢复了地真程序所使用的语义特性调用. 我们将预测和目标程序解析成Python AST,并提取多集的Cononical特征标签. 等效的 API 接口在适用时被映射到同一特性标签上,例如,槽和槽2D 都映射到槽上,推出点(pushPoint),拉阵(rarray),极地阵列被映射到阵列上. 由于地面真实和预测的特征多集M克M_{g}和MpM_{p},AR计算为F1分数:P=|M gM gM|M|,R=|M gM pM|M|M|,AR=2PR P+R. (原始内容存档于2018-09-31) (英语). P=\frac{|M_{g}\cap (原始内容存档于2018-09-29) (英语). M_{p}|}{|m_{p}|},\quad (原始内容存档于2018-03-21) (英语). R=\frac{|M_{g}\cap M_{p}|}{|M_{g}|},\quad AR=\frac{2PR}{P+R}. 没有地上真能特征的样本被排除在AR计算之外.

blocks.en: Equal Relation Score (ERS) measures preservation of explicit shared-parameter structure. We identify each variable that is referenced by two or more loop definitions as a shared parameter. Each shared parameter is represented by a structural signature consisting of its definition skeleton, its API argument roles, and the number of loops that reference it. Concrete variable names and numeric constants are abstracted in the skeleton, so the score focuses on whether the reusable parameter structure is preserved rather than whether the exact identifier names match. ERS is the fraction of ground-truth shared-parameter signatures greedily matched by the prediction. ERS is only reported for samples whose ground-truth programs contain shared parameters.
blocks.zh: 平等关系分数(ERS)措施 保留明确的共享参数结构. 我们把两个或两个以上循环定义所引用的每个变量确定为一个共享参数. 每个共享参数都由一个结构签名代表,包括它的定义骨架,它的API参数角色,以及引用它的回路数. 具体可变名称和数常数被抽象出骨架中,因此得分集中于可再用参数结构是否保留,而不是精确的标识名称是否相匹配. ERS是地面真实的共享参数签名的一小部分 与预测相匹配 ERS只用于地面真实程序包含共享参数的样本.

blocks.en: Parametric Relation Score (PRS) measures preservation of derived parameter expressions. A derived parameter is a variable whose right-hand side references at least one other variable. We represent each derived parameter by its expression skeleton and the number of referenced variables, and compute PRS as the fraction of ground-truth derived-relation signatures matched by the prediction. PRS is only reported for samples whose ground-truth programs contain derived parameter relations.
blocks.zh: 参数关系分数(PRS)测量了衍生参数表达式的保存. 衍生参数是一个变量,其右手边至少引用了另一个变量. 我们用其表达式骨架和引用变量的数量来代表每个衍生参数,并计算PRS作为地面-真实派生-关系签名与预测相匹配的一小部分. 只有地面-真实程序包含衍生参数关系的样本才报告减贫战略。

blocks.en: B.2 Edit Metrics
blocks.zh: B.2 编辑计量

blocks.en: Edit Success Rate (ES) measures whether the generated program correctly realizes the requested edit. A prediction is counted as successful if it satisfies two conditions: (1) the program executes into a valid CAD solid; and (2) the loops affected by the edit match the deterministic target program. The affected loops include the directly edited loop and any loops that should change to preserve the declared relation.
blocks.zh: 编辑成功率(ES)衡量生成的程序是否正确实现请求的编辑。 如果一个预测满足两个条件,则算作成功:(1)程序执行成有效的 CAD 固件;和(2) 受编辑影响的回路与确定目标程序相匹配. 受影响的回路包括直接编辑回路和任何应更改来保存所声明关系的回路.

blocks.en: The match is not based on string matching. For semantic loops, we compare the recovered feature type and resolved feature attributes, such as center, width, height, radius, angle, polygon points, slot dimensions, and fillet radius; variable names and expression surface forms are ignored after values are resolved. For primitive loops, we compare the resulting low-level segment/arc construction, and treat cyclic shifts and reversed traversal of the same closed loop as equivalent. Numeric values are compared with a tolerance of 10 − 5 10^{-5} . The final ES is the percentage of edit samples that satisfy these conditions.
blocks.zh: 匹配不是基于字符串匹配. 对于语义循环,我们比较了恢复的特征类型和已解决的特征属性,如中心,宽度,高度,半径,角度,多边形点,槽尺寸,和平方英尺半径等;变量名称和表达表层形式在数值解决后被忽略. 对于原始回路,我们比较所形成的低等分/弧构造,并将同闭路的回转和倒转等同. 数字值与容忍度相提并论为10 - 5 10 - 5 。 最终ES是符合这些条件的编辑样本的百分比.

blocks.en: Appendix C Edit Benchmark Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 编辑基准细节

blocks.en: C.1 Edit Benchmark Construction Pipeline
blocks.zh: C.1 编辑基准建设管道

blocks.en: We construct the edit benchmark by deterministic synthesis from the subset of IntentCAD-100K test set that contains both semantic and parametric lifting, without using LLM-generated targets. The purpose is to obtain aligned edit triples where the same edit instruction is applied to primitive-only, semantic-only, and semantic–parametric representations.
blocks.zh: 我们从IntentCAD-100K测试集的子集中通过确定性合成构建编辑基准,该测试集既包含语义提升,也包含参数提升,而不使用LLM生成的目标. 目的是在对原始的、语义的和语义的 - 参数化的表示方式适用同一编辑指令的情况下,获得对齐的编辑三重。

blocks.en: The synthesis follows a conservative pipeline similar to Stage I. We first identify editable local semantic features through AST parsing, and use loop/tag alignment to trace the affected loops across the three representations. The edit therefore is applied at the semantic level and then projected to the other representations: S . + P . S.{+}P. updates shared or derived variable assignments when applicable, S . S. rewrites the corresponding feature parameters, and the primitive representation ( − - ) regenerates the involved tagged loops as equivalent low-level primitive chains.
blocks.zh: 该合成遵循了类似于第一阶段的保守管线. 我们首先通过 AST 解析确定可编辑的本地语义特性, 并使用循环/tag 校正来追踪三个表达式中受影响的循环 。 因此,编辑应用在语义层面,然后预测到其他表述:S. + P. S. {+}P. 在适用的情况下更新共享或衍生的可变任务,S. S.重写了相应的特征参数,而原始的表示(−-)将被标记的环重生为等同的低等原始链.

blocks.en: We keep only candidates that pass several validations: all source and target programs must be syntactically valid and executable, the target must introduce a non-trivial geometric change from the source, and the three target programs must remain mutually consistent under a strict geometric tolerance 10 − 5 10^{-5} .
blocks.zh: 我们只保留通过多个验证的候选人:所有源和目标程序都必须在战术上有效且可执行,目标必须从源头引入非三角几何变化,三个目标程序必须在严格的几何可容性下保持相容性 10 — 5 10 — 5 }.

blocks.en: C.3 Edit Instruction Templates
blocks.zh: C.3 编辑指令模板

blocks.en: We use three types of edit template. Each instruction describes the requested modification and explicitly asks the model to keep the remaining relations unchanged.
blocks.zh: 我们使用三种类型的编辑模板。 每个指令都描述了所要求的修改,并明确要求模型保持所剩关系不变.

blocks.en: For parameter modifications, the instruction specifies the edited feature, loop identifier, attribute, old value, and new value: "Change the {attribute} of the {feature} in {loop} from {old_value} to {new_value}, and keep the other supported structures unchanged."
blocks.zh: 对于参数修改,指令指定了被编辑的特性,循环标识符,属性,旧值,以及新值:"将{地物}的{属性}从{old_value}更改为{new_value},并保持其他支持的结构不变".

blocks.en: For feature replacements, the instruction specifies the target feature and its required attributes: "Replace the geometry in {loop} with a {new_feature} feature, where {attribute descriptions}, and keep the design intent unchanged."
blocks.zh: 对于特性替换,该指令指定了目标特性及其所需的属性: “在{loop}中将几何学重置为{new_feature}特性,其中{属性描述},并保持设计意图不变。”

blocks.en: These instructions explicitly state an equality-style relation, such as EQUAL or CONCENTRIC, and ask the model to update one parameter while preserving the relation: "The following relation should be preserved: {affected slots} stay {relation}. Change {edited slot} from {old_value} to {new_value}, and keep the design intent unchanged."
blocks.zh: 这些指令明确规定了平等式关系,如EQUAL或CONCENTRIC,并要求模型在保留关系的同时更新一个参数: "以下关系应当保留: {被影响的槽} 保留{关系}. 从 {old_value} 改为 {new_value}, 并保持设计意图不变 。"

blocks.en: These instructions specify a derived relation such as MIRROR, RATIO, or DISTANCE, and ask the model to update the source parameter while preserving the relation: "The following relation should be preserved: {dependent slot} keeps a {relation} relation with {source slot}. Change {source slot} from {old_value} to {new_value}, and keep the design intent unchanged."
blocks.zh: 这些指令指定了MIRROR,RATIO,或DISTANCE等衍生关系,并要求模型在保留关系的同时更新源参数: “以下关系应予保留:{依赖槽}与{来源槽}保持{关系}关系。 将 {source slot} 从{old_value} 改为{new_value}, 并保持设计意图不变 。

blocks.en: D.2 Implementation Details.
blocks.zh: D.2 执行细节。

blocks.en:
All fine-tuning experiments are implemented with a standard LoRA-based supervised fine-tuning recipe [ 32 ] .
Unless otherwise specified, we use Qwen3.5-9B as the base model.
The backbone parameters are frozen, and only the LoRA adapters are updated.
LoRA is applied to both attention and feed-forward projection modules, including the query, key, value, output, gate, up, and down projections.
For each supervision representation, we train a separate LoRA adapter for three epochs using the same optimizer configuration, effective batch construction, learning-rate schedule, and sequence-length setting.
Thus, the controlled variants differ only in the supervision target representation.
During inference, all variants use the same decoding configuration and maximum generation length 4096.
All fine-tuning and evaluation experiments are conducted on 2 NVIDIA A100 40GB GPUs.
blocks.zh:
所有微调试验均采用基于标准LORA的有监督的微调配方[32].
除非另有说明,我们使用Quen3.5-9B作为基准模型.
主干参数被冻结,只有LORA适配器被更新.
LORA既用于注意,也用于向导投影模块,包括查询,密钥,值,输出,闸口,上下投影.
对于每个监督代表,我们为三个时代培训单独的LORA适配器,使用相同的优化器配置,有效的批量构造,学习率时间表,以及序列长度设定.
因此,受控变体仅在监督目标代表方面有所不同。
在推论期间,所有变体都使用相同的解码配置和最大生成长度4096.
所有微调和评价实验均在2个NVIDIA A100 40GB GPU上进行.

blocks.zh: D.3 诱饵和诱饵差异分析

blocks.en: All confidence intervals use percentile bootstrap with 10,000 resamples over test examples. For paired representation comparisons, the same example indices are resampled across representations. Positive differences indicate that the main representation performs better: for lower-is-better metrics such as IR and CD, we compute baseline minus main; for higher-is-better metrics, we compute main minus baseline.
blocks.zh: 所有置信间隔都使用有一万个重印的百分位靴子来代替测试实例. 对于对等的表述比较,同样的指数在表述中再次被复制。 积极差异表明,主要代表性表现较好:对于IR和CD等水平较低的比分计量标准,我们计算基线倒数;对于水平较高的比分计量标准,我们计算主比分基准。

blocks.en:
For controlled generation, Table 12 analyzes representation differences using paired bootstrap confidence intervals.
Semantic lifting yields supported improvements over primitive-only supervision: the intervals for IR and Mean CD are strictly positive.
Its role is instead evaluated through relation-oriented metrics: ERS and PRS are only meaningful when explicit shared parameters or derived relations exist, and are therefore reported as absolute scores for S . + P . S.+P. in Table 2 .

对于可控生成,表12使用对接的靴子置信间隔分析表示差异.

相反,它的作用是通过注重关系的衡量标准加以评价的: ERS和PRS只有在存在明确的共享参数或衍生关系时才有意义,因此在表2中作为S.+P.S.+P的绝对分数报告.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 13 , semantic lifting improves zero-shot editing over primitive supervision across all edit categories. Adding parametric lifting provides smaller but targeted gains: the difference is not supported for feature edits, but is supported for consistency and derived-relation edits. blocks.en: D.5 Semantic Versus Complexity
blocks.zh: D.5 语义维苏斯复杂度

blocks.en: Semantic lifting jointly changes feature abstraction, API names, program structure, and target length. To examine whether the benefits of semantic lifting arise solely from shorter targets, we evaluate two additional variants under the same controlled setup. Primitive with semantic comments ( Prim.+Cmt. ) retains the primitive programs while adding feature-level comments inspired by CADTalk [ 33 ] , without changing executable operations. Semantic with anonymous APIs ( S . S. -Anon. ) preserves the lifted feature structure and target token length but replaces meaningful API names with fixed anonymous aliases, which are restored before execution. This intervention is related to the semantics-preserving identifier perturbations studied in ReCode [ 34 ] .
blocks.zh: 语义提升联合改变特征抽象,API名称,程序结构,和目标长度. 为了审查语义提升的好处是否完全来自较短的目标,我们评价在同一控制设置下另外两个变体. 以语义注释为主(Prim.+Cmt.)保留了原始程序,同时添加受CADTalk[33]启发的特征级注释,而无需更改可执行操作. 有匿名API(S. S.-Anon.)的语义保留了被解除的特征结构和目标符号长度,但将有意义的API名替换为固定的匿名名,在执行前会恢复. 这种干预与ReCode [34]所研究的语义-保留识别符扰动有关.

blocks.en: Both variants are trained independently using the same backbone, data split, and fine-tuning settings, and evaluated on identical test prompts. In Prim.+Cmt. , feature comments are inserted before their corresponding primitive blocks, leaving the original operation sequence unchanged. In S . S. -Anon. , a fixed dataset-wide codebook is used to replace semantic API names, with aliases chosen to preserve target token length under the model tokenizer. The inverse mapping is applied before execution, ensuring that validity and geometry are evaluated using the standard CadQuery APIs. These variants do not fully disentangle semantic content from API familiarity, but provide complementary evidence on whether the observed gains can be explained by shorter targets alone.
blocks.zh: 这两种变体都使用相同的主干线、数据分解和微调设置进行独立培训,并在相同的测试提示上进行评估。 在Prim.+Cmt.中,特性注释被插入到它们相应的原始块之前,使原始操作序列保持不变. 在S.S.-Anon.中,使用固定的数据集宽码本来替换语义API名称,并用所选择的别名来在模型代号器下保留目标符号长度. 逆向映射在执行前被应用,确保使用标准的CadQuery API来评价有效性和几何. 这些变体并不完全脱离API熟悉的语义内容,而是提供了补充证据,说明所观察到的增益是否可以仅用较短的目标来解释.

The further improvement of S. shows that its compact feature-level abstraction provides additional gains. However, although S .
